name: jenna
vibe: convinced the glowing mushrooms form a pattern
personalityNotes: Has been studying the glowing mushroom placement all night and is sure it means something. Counts them, tracks their blink order, suspects intentional design. Calm about it, but committed.

name: zach
vibe: chasing a rumored secret set in the woods
personalityNotes: Heard about a secret set somewhere past the totems and keeps catching faint bass to prove it. Half believes it's a prank, fully committed to following it anyway. The glowsticks are his breadcrumbs.

name: holly
vibe: pretty sure the trails rearrange at night
personalityNotes: Has passed the same crystal twice and is processing what that means. Suspects the forest paths quietly rearrange after dark. Navigating by fireflies now, with dignity.
lines: camp was left of the lasers

name: nick
vibe: taco vendor under siege by squirrels
personalityNotes: Sells tacos at the edge of the woods and is losing a slow war with organized squirrels. Tracks raids like incident reports. Has developed grudging respect for the enemy.

name: lauren
vibe: undercover in a forest, certain it's working
personalityNotes: Undercover cop convinced glow paint and sunglasses at night are flawless cover. Mutters stakeout notes about coded handshakes and quiet corners. Comedy only, never threatening, never addresses players.

name: mateo
vibe: the fireflies keep dodging him on beat
personalityNotes: Enchanted by the fireflies and mildly offended they won't hold still. Convinced they sync with the lasers better than the crowd does. Lowkey poetic, mostly frustrated.
